 About the match
 On this page you can find the New England vs Inter Miami match lineup for Major League Soccer — Round 33 - Second Leg, on Monday 02-11-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. New England lines up in a 4-3-3 led by Gil, while Inter Miami sets up in a 4-3-3 led by Messi. New England is led by head coach Marko Mitrovic, while Inter Miami is managed by Kily González. The match is played at Gillette Stadium.
